hooks.command: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain src/ 2>/dev/null)" ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain docs/MIGRATION_QUERY_CHANGES.md 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Migration doc protocol not done: src/ has changes but docs/MIGRATION_QUERY_CHANGES.md is unmodified. Before finishing, run the protocol: (1) prepend the changelog entry in docs/MIGRATION_QUERY_CHANGES.md (newest first), (2) update the RESUME POINTER + wave checklist + change-log table in docs/migration/MONGO_ONLY_MIGRATION_PLAN.md, (3) add a row to docs/migration/MIGRATION_TRACKER.md + MIGRATION_TEST_LOG.md, (4) regenerate with yarn docs:migrated-modules, (5) update the migration-wave-status memory."}'; else echo '{}'; fi
